entities.summary: Josef Sami Boumedienne is a Swedish and Finnish hockey coach/scout and former professional hockey defenceman. He played in the National Hockey League (NHL) with the New Jersey Devils, Tampa Bay Lightning and Washington Capitals. He is currently the general manager for the Sweden men's national ice hockey team.
